Subject: Launch activation roundtable — QBR prep & cross-functional checkpoints

Team —

As we move into QBR prep, I want to run a tight, 45-minute activation roundtable focused on the bits that historically create last-mile friction: enablement readiness, pricing finalization, docs/API sample coverage, and support playbooks. Goal: identify blockers and confirm owners so we can lock the QBR narrative and the customer pilot milestones by EOD Friday.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 10m: Quick status by area (GTM / Enablement / Pricing / Docs / Support)
- 20m: Cross-team risks & decisions (what must be decided this week)
- 10m: Action owner mapping + timing
- 5m: Next steps for QBR deck & exec asks

Please review the attached activation_agenda_v1.pdf and add any must-have agenda items by EOD today. Also flag any items you will not be able to support this week so we can surface escalation early.

Meeting suggested slots: Thu 11a–12p PT or Fri 9a–9:45a PT. I’ll book once we have a preferred slot.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Group Product Lead, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: activation_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)]

Subject: Re: Launch activation roundtable — QBR prep & cross-functional checkpoints

Soojin — thank you for pulling this together. I reviewed the agenda and added a short enablement readiness checklist in the sheet (attachment). Quick notes:

- Enablement: core playbook + 3 role-based walkthroughs (AE/CS/Onboarding) must be complete by Thu COB; we have drafts for AE and CS but onboarding still needs runbook steps from Support.
- Docs: need two additional API examples (batch embeddings, streaming partials) — pinging Docs consult to estimate effort.
- Ops: need SLO language for Dedicated customers in the QBR ask slide — Vivek, can you confirm the SLA wording we can commit to for reserved capacity?

I’ve attached enablement_playbook_v2.xlsx as a starting point. I can present Enablement status in the roundtable if we take the Thu 11a slot.

Laura Bennett

Quick from Ops/Platform:

- SLA: we can offer 99.9% monthly availability for Dedicated with our current infra plan; for Hosted we should communicate a best-effort 99.5% baseline in the QBR and call out Dedicated as an elevated offering. I will draft exact language for the slide.
- Support: standard support hours cover 9–5 PT, 24/7 for P1 only. For Nimbus pilot (if they ask), we can offer 24/7 monitoring for the pilot period as a funded add-on — recommend we price that as a short-term service and include it in the pricing scenarios.

Markus — can you confirm the pricing scenario spreadsheet numbers? I left placeholder rows for the Nimbus pilot hourly monitoring add-on.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Dedicated & Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Soojin and team — happy to join the roundtable. A few quick clarifying questions from the Nimbus side before the meeting:

- Pilot metrics: Can you confirm the exact telemetry we’ll report during the pilot? We care about average latency, 95th pct, cost per 1k tokens, and failure rate.
- Support: 24/7 monitoring sounds good — would you provide a single POC for escalation? We will need an on-call contact for the pilot window.
- Commercial: we’ve seen the pricing scenarios shared in HubSpot but would appreciate a short one-pager with the pilot pricing and any overage rules.

If it helps, Helen (cc’d) from our integration team will join the roundtable too.

Best —
Helen Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Nimbus Retail

- Pricing for pilot monitoring add-on: Markus will populate the pilot pricing row and provide a preferred Ask for the QBR deck (due Wed EOD).
- SLA wording: Vivek will draft the exact SLA bullet (99.9% Dedicated; 99.5% Hosted baseline) and share in the drive link by Wed 9a PT.
- Docs examples: Docs consult to deliver the two API examples by Wed EOD; Kim to confirm doc owner for post-QBR publishing.

Owners (quick):

- Pilot telemetry one-pager: Soojin — deliver draft Tue EOD for Nimbus review.
- Pricing scenarios: Markus — update spreadsheet and add overage rules, Wed EOD.
- HubSpot/QBR slide: Karthik — consolidate final deck after roundtable, Fri 12p PT publish to exec folder.
